split: Entire bundled NUAA-SIRST training list (213 originals); no dev split; 214 test images reserved
model: Retrain-S1. Native greedy FP16 output before AdaIN and rounding; 0 additional updates in all arms.
operator: r = input - s1; K = [1,4,6,4,1]/16 vertically along rows with scipy reflect on unpadded frames; output = clip(s1 + alpha*(r-K*r),0,1)
primary: detail_full (alpha = 1) vs s1 (alpha = 0). Fixed strength on every image.
calibration_spots: Same 213 epoch 0 draw 0 templates and locations as the previous clean spot diagnosis; add each template to the possibly clipped minus input, then clip to [0,1]. Measure gain against the clean injected contrast and additionally against the realized input contrast.
outcomes: Spot contrast transfer, half-height width eligibility and paired width error; native_v2 whole-frame MAE and target contrast error, fixed background RMSE and weighted column residual, signed background bias. Each draw is a repeated observation of the same original.
paired_intervals: 5000 percentile bootstrap samples of original IDs with seed 20261121. Do not pool draws as independent images.
background_overlap: Descriptive on train. For each image both absolute paired column residual difference <=0.5 DN and absolute background RMSE difference <=1 DN, as used in the preceding TIDY control. Report subset coverage and paired native target contrast error; no image-specific tuning.
